notes.title: 1-DAY TOURNEY MAY 20
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

　　MAVR3D Tourney #1 will take place May 20, 2020, and lasts for 24 hours (Greenwich).

　　Please come to the ARENA at around any of the posted times to fight.  The winner of each type of weapon will receive special prizes including weapons and grand costumes good for three days (to be awarded the following day).  Yes, you can win at multiple weapons.

　　"Mavr'ed" is waiting for you to win.
